fr_livre_noun_f.hook: A block of butter balances a 500 g mass: UNE LIVRE, a French market pound.
fr_livre_noun_f.why: New integrated room; literal visible cue and correct contextual sense.
fr_livre_noun_f.note: Une livre is feminine. In French market usage it is 500 g. Un livre is a book. Currency is a separate sense.
ex: Une livre de cerises, s’il vous plaît.

fr_cote_noun_3.hook: A clipboard gives the model a RATING of 4/5: cote. Plain depiction.
fr_cote_noun_3.why: Contextual picture for the restaurant/maths completion; weak inherited puns replaced with plain depiction.

fr_angle_noun.hook: A tick-marked protractor shows an ANGLE. No numeric degree claim is made.
